_comment: Y-45 phone push. Copy to config/push_notify.json (gitignored) and set enabled to true only after the operator acts in core/operator_push.py are done. token MUST be a reference: {"env": NAME} (a user env var) or {"file": path} (first non-blank line of a gitignored file). server and topic may be literals here or references. Links in messages must use a tailnet hostname; loopback links are refused. tailnet_suffix MUST be replaced with your own tailnet (the placeholder or a bare .ts.net refuses to arm).
